analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: We also obtain data about you from Microsoft affiliates, subsidiaries, and third parties.

analysis.headline: Shares for Personalized Ads
analysis.quote: We also share personal data for digital advertising purposes. When you visit a website or use an app that wants to show you ads, the digital property may allow Microsoft to access or receive device data or certain other data identified in the Personal data we collect section above. We may then share this information with third party advertising platforms and advertisers to facilitate the delivery and measurement of ads on such digital properties.

analysis.headline: Buys Your Data from Brokers
analysis.quote: Data brokers from which we purchase demographic data to supplement the data we collect.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Data
analysis.quote: As part of our efforts to improve and develop our products, we may use your data to develop and train our AI models.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Voice Data
analysis.quote: Voice data. Your voice data, sometimes referred to as “voice clips”, such as search queries, commands, or dictation you speak, which may include background sounds.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric Data
analysis.quote: Biometric data and identifiers. Data about you resulting from specific technical processing relating to your physical, physiological, or behavioral characteristics which allow or confirm unique identification.

analysis.headline: Records Your Video & Audio
analysis.quote: Video or recordings. Recordings of events and activities at Microsoft buildings, retail spaces, and other locations. If you enter Microsoft Store locations or other facilities, or attend a Microsoft event that is recorded, we may process your image and voice data.

analysis.headline: Scans Your Private Content
analysis.quote: For example, some of our products, such as Outlook.com or OneDrive, systematically scan content in an automated manner to identify suspected spam, viruses, abusive actions, or URLs that have been flagged as fraud, phishing, or malware links; and we reserve the right to block delivery of a communication or remove content if it violates our terms.

analysis.headline: Monitors Your Support Calls
analysis.quote: When you contact us, such as for customer support, phone conversations or chat sessions with our representatives may be monitored and recorded.
